description: Redemption Legguards Level 60 Commander Eligor Dawnbringer at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a pair of Redemption Legguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Legguards - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 20 - Arcanite Bar x 4 - Nexus Crystal x 2
